newsitem.title: UK: Cordiant Plc -- the constituent parts.
newsitem.headline: Cordiant Plc -- the constituent parts.

text.p: Following are details of the constituent parts of advertising holding company Cordiant Plc , which announced plans on Monday to split into three independently managed businesses.
million pounds ($588 million) * Trading profit: 23.5 million pounds

* Saatchi & Saatchi worldwide advertising network operates in 90 countries. Multi-national clients include DuPont, Hewlett-Packard, Kodak, Procter & Gamble and Toyota. * Siegel & Gale. New York-based, traditional business involves corporate and brand identity and now expanding in interactive multimedia services. * The Facilities Group. London-based, provides integrated production of print, TV, audivisual and interactive multimedia.
THE BATES GROUP: * Revenue: 375 million pounds *
* Bates network operates in 75 countries for clients such as Avis, BAT, Hyundai and Warner-Lambert. The network claims particular strength in Asia Pacific region.
* Scholz & Friends. Headquartered in Hamburg, an advertising network with offices across Europe and now in the Far East.

* Rowland Worldwide. New York-based PR consultancy, operates in Europe, Asia and Australia. * National Research Group. Market research firm for the film and entertainment industry, located in Los Angeles. * HP:ICM. Communications group which organises live events such as conferences as well as print and video work. ZENITH MEDIA WORLDWIDE:
* Media services agency, operating in 22 countries. Clients include BMW, Bell Atlantic, Halifax and Jacobs Suchard.
